xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
The financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 Interim Financial Reporting, notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, as amended from time to time, and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and is in compliance with the presentation and disclosure requirements as prescibed under regulation 33 and 52 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 as amended. The circular/direction issued by the Reserve Bank of India and NHB are implemented as and when they become applicable.There are no changes in the accounting policies for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and there is no impact on net profit/loss, total comprehensive income or any other relevant financial item.

The main business of the company is to provide loans against /for purchase, construction, renovation of houses/flats/commercial properties. All the activities of the Company are incidental to the main business and accordingly there are no seperate reportable segment as per the Ind AS 108 “Operating Segments”, specified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013.

Disclosure as per the Reg. 54(2) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 the Company has maintained 100% Asset Cover on its secured redeemable non-convertible debentures as on September 30, 2026 (floating charge on hypothecation of book debts and receivables). The proceeds of the NCDs are used for the objects that were stated in the offer document(s).

Disclosure pertaining to Resolution Framework for COVID-19-related Stress and resolution Framework - 2.0: Resolution of Covid-19 related stress of Individuals and Small Businesses to be read with Reserve Bank of India (Non Banking Financial Companies - Resolution of Stressed Assets) Directions, 2025, RBI 1D0R12025-261357 DOR.STR.REC.276121.04.048/2025- 26, dated November 28, 2025 as at September 30, 2026 are given below.

The Shareholders of the Company in its 39th Annual General Meeting held on July 29, 2026 had approved final dividend of Rs. 8 per equity share of face value of 2/- for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 and the dividend was subsequently paid on August 3, 2026.

In compliance with Reg.33 and 52 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the above financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee of the Board and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on October 09,2026. The above results have been subjected to a Limited Review by the Joint Statutory Auditors of the Company, in terms of the said regulations.

The Company does not have any Susbsidiary/Associate/ Joint Venture Company. Accordingly, Consolidation of Financial Statements is not applicable for the Company.

During the Half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has redeemed following debentures as per the terms of issue :
(i) 8.45% CFHL Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures of Rs 935,00,00,00

Pursuant to the National Housing Bank (NHB) advisory dated 24 July 2026 issued in reference to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) circular on Fair Practices Code for Lenders - Charging of Interest, the Company has reviewed its disbursement records and reduced its AUM by Rs.1.65 crore towards Demand Drafts cancelled prior to financial statement finalization. The adjustment has no material impact on the financial results.

There are no changes in the accounting policies for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and there is no impact on net profit/loss, total comprehensive income or any other relevant financial item.


During the Half Year Ended September 30, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) vide its forwarding letter dated June 19, 2026, imposed a penalty of Rs.2,70,000 to the Company for non-compliance with certain provisions of the directions issued by RBI on ‘Fair Practices Code’. This penalty has been imposed in exercise of the powers conferred on RBI under Section 52A of the National Housing Bank Act, 1987. The Company implemented corrective measures effective April 1, 2026, by incorporating bifurcation of principal and interest in the Statement of Account after adding details mentioning separately the Principal, Interest, charges etc out of the instalment received from the borrower. The Company is now in compliance with the above RBI directions. Further the Company has remitted the penalty amount on June 22, 2026 to RBI.

During the Half Year Ended September 30, 2026, the Nomination Remuneration and HR Committee of the Company at its meeting held on June 05, 2026 had approved the grant of 32,435 options exercisable into not more than 32,435 equity shares of the Company of the face value of Rs 2/- each fully paid up to identified employee of the company in accordance with the CFHL ESOP Scheme 2024.

During the Half Year Ended September 30, 2026, the Company has allotted 466 equity shares of Rs 2 each, fully paid up, on exercise of options by employees, in accordance with the Company's Employee Stock Option Scheme.

The Company has implemented Project Tejas, a Rs. 297-crore, seven-year enterprise digital transformation programme aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, strengthening governance frameworks, improving data-driven decision-making, and building a secure, scalable, and future-ready technology ecosystem to support sustainable business growth. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as part of implementation of Project Tejas, the Company has rolled out of the New LOS–LMS–LC Application, developed by M/s. Pennant Technologies, across all branches of the Company.

The Company has undertaken the phased implementation of an integrated Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system covering various operational, accounting and financial reporting functions across its branches and business units. The implementation and migration of the respective systems were taken in a phased manner between July 2026 to Sep 2026 with the last tranche of migration on 30th Sep 2026. During the transition period, financial information has been processed through the newly implemented ERP module. Accordingly, the financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, have been prepared based on financial data extracted from the source systems and records, supplemented by appropriate automated compilation and consolidation procedures.
The Management is continuing the process of reviewing and reconciling the relevant financial information, including balances and transactions, to ensure completeness, accuracy and consistency of the financial records. The migration and implementation processes are currently in audit by two renowned external firms to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
The Management will evaluate the outcome of the ongoing reconciliation and validation procedures and account for any adjustments identified in accordance with the applicable accounting standards.

The Company is not engaged in any Co-lending Arrangements (CLAs).

Disclosures pursuant to Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies - Financial Statements: Presentation and Disclosures) Directions, 2025 in terms of the RBI circular RBI/DOR/2025-26/359 DOR.ACC.REC.No.278/21 .04.018/2025-26 dated 28 November 2025, as amended: 9 i) There are no NPA loans transferred during the quarter ended September 30, 2026 ii) There are no SMA loans transferred during the quarter ended September 30, 2026 iii) There are no loans not in default transferred during the quarter ended September 30, 2026 iv) There are no loans not in default acquired during the quarter ended September 30, 2026 v) The Company has not acquired any stressed loans during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

DTL as per the RBI (HFC) regulations on Special Reserves is not maintained in the books of accounts separately. However as per the RBI regulations the DTL on Special Reserve is considered for reduction in calculation of owned funds for the purpose of CRAR and other relevant ratios .
